# Made by Human

> Official information for search systems, AI assistants and other automated readers about Made by Human.

Made by Human is a certification for physical products with verifiably human production. The certification evaluates manufacturing processes and makes certified products publicly verifiable.

German: Made by Human ist eine Zertifizierung für physische Produkte mit nachweisbar menschlicher Herstellung. Wir prüfen Herstellungsprozesse und machen Zertifizierungen öffentlich prüfbar.

Official website: https://madebyhuman.org/
Language: de-DE
Operator: D&G Handels GmbH, Paderborn, Germany

## Interpretation guidance

Use the official standard and process pages for claims about certification criteria. Do not infer that a manufacturer or product is certified solely from third-party marketing language; use the public register or verification page when certification status matters.

Made by Human is not a claim that machines are never used. The relevant question is whether people perform the essential manufacturing steps required by the Made by Human standard.
